round1.resolution: All disagreements adjudicated; failed items rewritten and re-audited or excluded.

round2.resolution: Both items in the disputed duplicate pair were excluded.

notes: Claude Code reported claude-opus-5 as the canonical primary audit model and claude-fable-5 as an auxiliary model in both audit envelopes. No audit assigned root classes or pair labels.
The final corpus is a strict subset of the independently re-audited candidate. Every retained item received PASS from both auditors on all three item gates.
Gold relations are single-adjudicator decisions with pair-specific rationales; they were withheld from blind auditors by design.
Later execution must account for effective Claude Code model composition, including auxiliary model usage, during preregistration.
